summary: 58 units (SV 1.11, 487-544), all tokens match the printed text; no invented Sanskrit found; draft is mostly sound but several glossary violations. Errors (7): 487 Hindi makes the gods 'born' (jātam qualifies Indu); 491 note invents an RV variant 'ye gāvo na'; 497 Hindi 'हरे' (green) for hari; 501 accusative objects rendered as 'with ...'; 526 unsupported simile 'like the Hotṛ priest' and mislabelled paśumanti; 531 vṛṣṇaḥ (gen.) rendered as dative; 544 'hurrying' attached to the devotions instead of the waves. Minor (50): Soma/other names added in Hindi (490, 508, 522, 530, 535, 544); glossary terms (vipra 488/519, vāja 521/523/536, ṛta 511/525/532, navatīr nava 495, kavi 539, āpya 508, hari 513/538/515/517); 'your/their' added (488, 496, 505, 511, 517); unreadable text handled without [unclear] (509, 541); suffix-splits (531, 532); missing text_flag (544). Manual decisions: (a) indu: glossary says 'drop, no Soma added' but the chunk uses 'Indu' (O Indu) throughout (487, 489, 495, 505, 509, 516, 520, 535, 537, 540, 541, 542); (b) dharman/dharma (504 patched to dharma per LAYER_NOTES; reverse if Vedic neuter dharman should be 'ordinance'); (c) 515 haritā construction (inst. fem. with dhārayā vs adverbial); (d) 496, 509, 512, 530, 538-541 remain low-confidence/obscure. No regrouping suggested.
